entries.translation: ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ ਪਹਿਨੋ। ਸੱਭਿਆਚਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਲੈ ਚੱਲੋ।
entries.transliteration: Andāz pahino. Sabbhiācār nāl lai challo.
entries.note: Gurmukhi selected; polite gender-neutral imperative.

entries.translation: سبکی که به تن می‌کنی. فرهنگی که با خود می‌بری.
entries.transliteration: Sabkī ke be tan mīkonī. Farhangī ke bā khod mībarī.
entries.note: Natural informal-singular slogan.

entries.translation: सकं वेसं परिदहसि। आचारं वहसि।
entries.note: Devanagari selected among Pali’s multiple scripts; classical-language expert review required.

entries.translation: Styl, który nosisz. Kultura, którą niesiesz.
entries.note: Natural parallel construction; niesiesz supports embodied metaphor.

entries.translation: Estilo que vestes. Cultura que levas contigo.
entries.note: European Portuguese selected for Bisti’s France/Cabo Verde context; Brazilian Portuguese requires separate localization.

entries.translation: هغه طرز چې اغوندې؛ هغه کلتور چې له ځانه سره وړې.
entries.transliteration: Hagha tarz che aghwandē; hagha kaltūr che la dzāna sara wṛē.
entries.note: Standard Pashto script; informal singular.

entries.translation: P’achawan rikch’ayniyki rikuchiy. Kawsayniykita purichiy.
entries.note: Southern Quechua, Cusco-Collao; poetic ‘make your culture walk’; native review required.

entries.translation: Il stil che ti portas. La cultura che ti portas en tai.
entries.note: Supraregional Rumantsch Grischun selected; culture carried ‘within.’

entries.translation: Stilul pe care îl porți. Cultura pe care o porți cu tine.
entries.note: Latin-script Romanian standard, also used officially in Moldova.

entries.translation: Uburyo wambara. Umuco ugendana.
entries.note: Style transcreated as ‘the way you dress’; native slogan review required.

entries.translation: Стиль — на тебе. Культура — в тебе.
entries.transliteration: Stilʹ — na tebe. Kulʹtura — v tebe.
entries.note: Idiomatic body/identity contrast; avoids physical-hauling sense.

entries.translation: Yû mode tî mo. Bata culture tî mo na bê.
entries.note: ‘Keep your culture in your heart’; established French-derived terms; native review required.

entries.translation: स्वशैलीं परिदधासि। संस्कृतिं वहसि।
entries.note: Grammatical poetic Sanskrit best effort; classical-language expert review advised.

entries.translation: ඔබ අඳින විලාසය. ඔබ දරාගෙන යන සංස්කෘතිය.
entries.transliteration: Oba andina vilāsaya. Oba darāgena yana saṃskṛtiya.
entries.note: Balanced relative clauses; native copy review advised.

entries.translation: Štýl nosíš na sebe. Kultúru nosíš v sebe.
entries.note: Native parallel: ‘on yourself / within yourself.’

entries.translation: Slog nosiš na sebi. Kulturo nosiš v sebi.
entries.note: Natural balanced body/identity construction.

entries.translation: Bivttastat iežat stilii. Guottát iežat kultuvrra.
entries.note: Standard Northern Sámi; inflection and slogan register need native review.

entries.translation: O lou sitaili e te ofuina. O lou aganuʻu e te tauaveina.
entries.note: Balanced modern Samoan; sitaili is an established loan.

entries.translation: Chimiro chaunopfeka. Tsika dzaunotakura.
entries.note: Style rendered as appearance; tsika conveys cultural customs.

entries.translation: انداز جيڪو اوهان پايو ٿا. ثقافت جيڪا اوهان سان گڏ هلي ٿي.
entries.transliteration: Andāz jeko ohān pāyo thā. Saqāfat jekā ohān sāṇ gaḍu halē thī.
entries.note: Standard Arabic-based Sindhi; culture rendered as accompanying you.

entries.translation: Qaabka aad u labisato. Dhaqanka aad xambaarsan tahay.
entries.note: Idiomatic: style as how you dress; culture as what you embody.

entries.translation: Setaele seo u se aparang. Setso seo u se jarang.
entries.note: Setaele is established usage; native review advised for figurative jara.

entries.translation: El estilo que vistes. La cultura que llevas contigo.
entries.note: Region-neutral and idiomatic.

entries.translation: S’istile chi bestis. Sa cultura chi portas.
entries.note: Limba Sarda Comuna-style broad standard; dialectal variants expected.

entries.translation: Стил који носиш. Култура коју носиш са собом.
entries.transliteration: Stil koji nosiš. Kultura koju nosiš sa sobom.
entries.note: Serbian Cyrillic selected; Latin script equally standard.

entries.translation: Gqoka sitayela sakho. Phatsa lisiko lakho.
entries.note: Standard style loan; figurative phatsa needs native review.

entries.translation: Gaya nu dianggo. Budaya nu dijungjung.
entries.note: Carry transcreated as ‘uphold,’ avoiding physical-hauling sense.

entries.translation: Vaa mtindo wako. Beba utamaduni wako.
entries.note: Native core vocabulary; concise imperative slogan.

entries.translation: Stilen du bär. Kulturen du bär med dig.
entries.note: Idiomatic parallel use of bär.

entries.translation: A fa’a’ahu i tō ’oe huru. A amo i tō ’oe peu.
entries.note: Style as appearance and culture as custom; orthography and idiom need native review.

entries.translation: நீ அணியும் பாணி. நீ ஏந்தும் பண்பாடு.
entries.transliteration: Nī aṇiyum pāṇi. Nī ēntum paṇpāṭu.
entries.note: Natural balanced clauses; ஏந்தும் conveys bearing and embodying.
